# Malformed intents (Engine v2 I2, #2689), one per line: `fixture expected-refusal hex`. Each is refused by the

# the WASM build in Node in v2/tools/ci.sh. The names are the registry's (src/refusals.rs). The bytes are hex
# text, since the path guard refuses a tracked file with a zero byte in its first 8,000 bytes.
